message.content:
After reviewing Elena Soto's and David Okafor's calendars, it appears that none of the times that work for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale are suitable.

I have identified a new list of times where both Elena and David are available. I will now post this to our shared workspace so Alison can compare it with Priya's and Marcus's calendars.

I've concluded that I need to pinpoint common free slots for Elena and David and then relay that to Alison for further comparison with Priya and Marcus' schedules. So, I've started the process of identifying common free slots for Elena and David. I have analyzed their schedules for the upcoming week and identified the slots where both of them are free. I'll provide this updated list to Alison so she can assess these times against the schedules of Priya and Marcus.

Unfortunately, none of the proposed times are viable due to existing commitments for Elena and David. I have identified the common free slots for next week between them and will pass that list to Alison, along with an explanation of why the initial options won't work.
